title: Starting this site
excerpt: Why I finally put a personal site together, and what I plan to use it for.
content:
I've been meaning to put a proper personal site together for a while. This is the first real entry.

The plan is simple: keep a CV and project list somewhere I fully control, and use this space for shorter, less polished writing than I'd post anywhere else.
